items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: That trio was Sy Oliver, Eddie Tompkins, and Willie Smith. And when I came in the band he made a quartet.

ctx.x: That trio was Sy Oliver, Eddie Tompkins, and Willie Smith. And when I came in the band he made a quartet. He added me onto the trio, and they did a couple of things that became very popular. One was "Ain't She Sweet" and the other was "Cheating on Me". And --
But it says the Jimmy Lunceford Quartet or the Lunceford Quartet vocals --
